wc26.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
wc26.infoTooltip:
Canada · Mexico · USA — 104 matches in total. Kick-off times are shown in Berlin (UTC+2). Schedule, standings and playoffs come from the FriendlyBets tournament archive.

Group stage betting rules:
• Each round is split into slots in chronological order by time.
• Rounds 1 and 2: 6 slots of 4 matches — 2 bets for each slot.
• Round 3: 4 slots of 6 matches — 3 bets per slot.

From the knockout stage onwards, bets must be submitted for each match.

standings.bestThirdHint: Top 8 third-placed teams advance to the Round of 32
standings.tiebreakerTitle: Ranking when teams are level on points
standings.tiebreakerIntro: If two or more teams in the same group are equal on points, the following criteria apply in order:
standings.tiebreaker1: most points in matches between the tied teams;
standings.tiebreaker2: superior goal difference in matches between them;
standings.tiebreaker3: most goals scored in matches between them;
standings.tiebreaker4: superior goal difference in all group matches;
standings.tiebreaker5: most goals scored in all group matches;
standings.tiebreaker6: highest fair play score (fewer yellow and red cards);
standings.tiebreaker7: national team ranking (most recent published edition).
standings.tiebreakerThird: Among best third-placed teams: points → goal difference → goals scored → fair play → ranking.
standings.tiebreakerPositions: Standings order follows the tournament archive.

siteAccessProbeHint: Before integrating a new source: paste the home URL (or any public page). The request runs from the app server — localhost is not equal to prod. PASS = Java can usually fetch; CLOUDFLARE_JS_CHALLENGE = same as aiscore, do not start integration.

siteAccessProbeVerdictHint.PASS: No JS challenge. Safe to try a parser/SPI.
siteAccessProbeVerdictHint.CLOUDFLARE_JS_CHALLENGE: Same protection as aiscore: Java from this host will not pass. Use another source or a proxy.
siteAccessProbeVerdictHint.HTTP_BLOCKED: Site returned an HTTP error. Possibly geo/bot block — check status and snippet.
siteAccessProbeVerdictHint.NETWORK_ERROR: Request did not complete. Check URL and server network.
